policy.fleet_scope: all recoverable vehicles, not one-at-a-time hero work

source_fusion.rule: Search and exploit both Beta1 and Beta2 for every active vehicle. Choose the strongest owner-authorized body, interior, wheels, tyres, lights, glass, materials, textures, rigging, damage parts and LOD source from either library; combine complementary components when provenance and fit are valid. Do not stop after finding one usable source in one beta.
beta1_roles: CarX Highway and Gangstar vehicle candidates where recovered and verified
beta2_roles: Real Racing 3 vehicle/LOD/material/audio reference and recoverable source where authorized
other Beta2 vehicle-support assets when provenance is verified
source_fusion.promotion_gate: No active vehicle is production-complete until both Beta1 and Beta2 have been searched for that vehicle/component family and the selected cross-library source set is recorded.

crown007.rule: Crown007 is the accepted reference-quality vehicle. Never degrade it. Apply shared fleet improvements only when they preserve or improve the accepted result.

porsche.rule: Porsche recovery is owner-authorized in this vehicle-production lane. Exact model, generation and trim evidence remains mandatory. Never relabel an unrelated Porsche generation as a 992; preserve exact source identity and provenance for every recovered component.

vehicle_lane_owns: forward/reverse/steering/braking behavior in isolated vehicle test scene
clean reset/despawn without duplicate or orphan nodes
lane_boundary.integration_rule: Keep vehicle-production separate from map-cars-reset-001 until map visual acceptance.

vehicles.remaining_work_policy: Keep current accepted state stable. Permit shared-fleet improvements only when non-regressive.

beta1.material_recovery: PaintStitches alpha/depth/normal-map behavior recovered; broader close-view cleanup remains useful

vehicles.rule: Do not relabel as Mark X. Build the final Chaser from the best compatible Beta1+Beta2 component set, then author missing LODs.

beta1.warning: Toyota Mark 2 and Toyota Chaser V are distinct vehicles and are not Mark X substitutes.

vehicles.rule: Do not promote until exact Mark X identity is verified; once found, still search the other beta for complementary parts/materials/LODs.

Recover Porsche source components only with exact source identity/provenance. A Porsche hit is not sufficient evidence of 992 identity; unrelated generations or trims must remain separately identified and must never be relabeled as a 992.
